generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
It shall be the responsibility of the bidder to furnish all the particulars which are required for due consideration of the tender though not mentioned in the specification
Tender validity shall be 180 days from the date specified for last date for submission of the tender
The right to reject any or all tenders without assigning the reasons is reserved by the Chief Engineer (FM), BTPS.

The bidder should submit details of place of residence and postal address. The delivery at the above name, place or position in the post box regularly maintained by the post office or sending by letter registered for acknowledgement or other communications shall be deemed sufficient proof thereof
The submission of tender by a contractor implies that he has read these notices and conditions of contract and made himself aware of the scope of the work to be done.
It is not binding on the KPCL to accept the lowest or any other tender.

Contractors shall have to be financially sound. They cannot depend on KPCL monthly bill payment to pay labors. The Labors must be paid by 10th of every month. No delay in this statutory compliance shall be tolerated.

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)
Executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work (Cement Concrete - xxxx cum, Earthwork - xxxx cum, etc) (80% of peak rate of construction)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Owning the following key and critical equipment for this work (xxxx, xxxx, xxxx)
Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. xxxxxx Lakhs (estimated cash flow for 3 months of peak construction period)
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
List of Financial Resources with Certificates

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily executed and completed as a prime contractor of at least one contract and its extensions pertaining to Routine and or Breakdown maintenance of the mechanical equipments like Wagon tipplers, Primary crushers, Secondary crushers, Stacker cum reclaimers, Travelling tipplers in coal handling plants in any thermal power plant of capacity 210 MW or above of value not less than Rs.128.58 lakhs (excluding GST) in any one year during the preceding five years. The intended bidder shall upload the scanned copy of original satisfactory work done certificate from Govt Organisation reputed private organization issued by competent authority in any of the preceding five years. Work done of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited

The intending bidder in his name should have a minimum annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.514.30 lakhs (excluding GST) in any of the two years of preceding five years and should upload the scanned copy of original latest audited balance sheets including profit and loss account for preceding five completed financial years countersigned by charted accountant as documentary evidence (Financial turnover of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited.)
